raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-398 refactor of silver_transactions changed txn_date to derive from ingest_ts instead of txn_ts. Each batch is ingested at 02:00 the day after the transactions occur, so all 4600 POSTED rows were assigned the next day's date, which shifts every daily gold aggregate by one day. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the correct business date and matches the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor's definition.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
